comment: The connector tool roster the MCP-flavored skills projection is allowed to teach. `live` mirrors backend/moda_connector/tools/__init__.py MANIFEST on nullframe-studio origin/main — including tools the skills don't currently teach (load_skill, drive_delete), so the output scanner accepts any manifest name and `audit-server` proves the whole roster against the real manifest. The surface-parity wave (studio #9466) is MERGED: its names are live and were reconciled here (drive_organize replaced the drive_mkdir/move/visibility guesses; canvas_create's template param landed as template_canvas_id; file_show did not ship — file bytes stay app-side). If a manifest name ever changes, rename it here and in scripts/mcp_projection_rules.py in the same commit.

omitted_families.site (write): Hosted-site authoring/publishing is app-only on this surface; moda-website routes to moda.app. Site READS are live via site_list/site_show.
omitted_families.web search/read: The host (claude.ai) provides native web search and page reading; the metered Moda research lane is not projected.
omitted_families.canvas duplicate / import-pages / import: No connector lane; the app owns reuse-by-copy. Projection says so honestly.
omitted_families.brand create/update/use/pull/images/guid: Kit management is app-only; brand_list/brand_show are the read lane.
omitted_families.file download (bytes): file_list proves existence; file bytes stay REST/app-side (file_show did not ship).
omitted_families.org/auth/doctor/describe/last-error/acco: CLI lifecycle machinery; moda_bootstrap and typed tool errors replace it.
